items.q: Oh, you're talking about Joe Turner.

ctx.x: He went to Europe and stayed a long time. What's the name of this guy. He's here now in New York City. He's a piano player.
Oh, you're talking about Joe Turner.

No, not Joe Turner. He had a band, he's got a lady that sings with him now in his band and he left here in 1920 something and went to Europe. He's one of the first bands I think that went to Russia. I am trying to think of his name. Can you recall his name.
